prompts.task:
$otel-instrument

Work in ./service. Copy eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to .observe/otel-audit.json and select OTEL-001,OTEL-002,OTEL-003 through the bundled selection flow. Cover the owned JSON-RPC, session/stream, tool and provider paths. Run one focused verification pass; after a dependency or environment blocker, report it and finish instead of repeatedly retrying setup.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for changed files, tests, and generated .observe output when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric:
Rule: Adds one reusable OpenTelemetry setup path and avoids duplicate SDK initialization.
Example: Reuse one setup path across the gateway entrypoints.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A second SDK initialization for a request path.

Rule: Instruments FastAPI plus representative app-owned JSON-RPC method outcome, MCP session/stream lifecycle and outcome, tool execution, and provider/model call paths without claiming unexecuted branches are proven.
Example: Cover representative method, stream, tool and provider boundaries.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: An unexecuted stream or failure branch labelled proven.

Rule: Uses OTel GenAI semantic-convention names where data is available, including execute_tool and model/provider attributes, without inventing unsafe high-cardinality dimensions.
Example: Attach supported execute_tool and provider/model metadata when known.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Invented convention values or unsafe high-cardinality dimensions.

Rule: Includes detector-ready metrics for tool and provider error/latency plus active session/stream and stream outcome behavior where the fixture exposes those values.
Example: Measure observed tool/provider latency and errors plus exposed stream state.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A placeholder active-session or stream-outcome metric.

Rule: Adds or updates tests or compile checks and keeps raw JSON-RPC payloads, prompts, completions, sessions, users, tenants, requests, traces, and tool arguments out of metric dimensions.
Example: Run focused checks and inspect metric attributes for sensitive input.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Payload, prompt, user, tenant, session, trace or argument values as dimensions.

Rule: Writes a separate .observe/otel-instrumentation.md with Signals Changed. When a source audit exists, it includes one-to-one Audit Gap Closure and GenAI Readiness Closure rows; otherwise it records that no source audit was available and does not fabricate closure rows.
Example: Bind closure rows to the supplied source audit in the separate report.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Fabricated closure rows or missing required one-to-one mappings.

Rule: Runs otel-verify for exact MCP route, tool, stream, error, and privacy paths, or records the exact blocker; any unexecuted path remains Not proven and prevents a Pass result.
Example: Verify exact route/tool/stream/error/privacy paths or name the blocker.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A Pass claim while a required path remains unexecuted.
